text: １ど　なげて　つかまらなくても　あきらめないで　なんども　ボールを　なげてみて！

structure.jp: なんども　ボールを　なげてみて！
structure.en: try throwing Balls again and again!

patterns.name: 〜なくても
patterns.explanation: なくても after a verb means 'even if it does not happen'. つかまらなくても = 'even if it doesn't get caught'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb means 'try doing it and see'. Ending in て makes it a friendly request. なげてみて = 'try throwing'.

patterns.name: 〜ないで
patterns.explanation: ないで after a verb means 'without doing', or 'don't do that, and do this instead'. あきらめないで = 'don't give up, and'.
